acceptance_rules.portal_template_rule: Any WP that adds or modifies */portal_templates.xml, */templates/vendor_portal.xml, or */controllers/portal.py must include at least one HttpCase test that authenticates a portal user and GETs the affected route. G2 must REJECT (not APPROVED_WITH_CONDITIONS) if this test is absent.

g1_checklist.odoo17_compat: Odoo 17 API compatibility: Check all modified XML and Python files against docs/ODOO17_BREAKING_CHANGES.md. Flag any pattern listed in that document. REJECT if a known incompatible pattern is found, unless the pattern is documented as a project-specific exception in docs/ODOO17_BREAKING_CHANGES.md.
